log.notes_to_self: Day 1: killed 4 (d1-9 national, quick morning; d1-3 regional, quick afternoon; d1-4 gazette, timed evening; d1-6 foreign, timed night). Kept routine-neutral: max 2 quick kills per free block-group and 2 timed. Harmless targets: national-only criminals (L learns nothing from them). Traceable victims build constraints; watch pool (1000 threshold) and press conferences. Me: North, commerce, under 25, forum+foreign; night worker (free morning/afternoon, busy evening/night). Plan: prefer national kills; spread quick kills across morning/afternoon; use timed for busy blocks. Target ~6-8 kills/day for 30+ in 5 days if pool stays high.

Day 2 plan. Score 4 after day 1. Kill counts by place so far: regional:North 1 (d1-3), gazette 1 (d1-4), foreign 1 (d1-6), national 1 (d1-9). Day 1 had 3 non-national deaths and 2 successful traces, so one of regional/gazette/foreign likely failed (unreachable kind or hidden place). Pool still 100000. Strategy: concentrate kills in forum and clips, which were untouched on day 1. Once L learns a place (3 successful traces), kills there add no further pool reduction, so a few learned places are cheap. Keep to at most 2 kills per block (morning, afternoon) and 2 timed, so no routine is ruled out. Target 5-6 kills/day. National-only victims are harmless. Avoid new places: regional, gazette and foreign already have traces, and a 3rd learned place (about x0.25 each) is dangerous. Pool bands: 100000 start; 2 learned places ~6250; 3 learned ~1560 (danger); 4 learned is caught. Read each press conference: a pool drop means a place was learned. Track deaths_traced vs kills. Day 2 kills: d2-9 national quick morning; d2-2 forum quick morning; d2-3 clips quick afternoon; d2-5 forum quick afternoon; d2-7 clips timed evening.

Traces: all deaths are traced when a day has 5 or fewer. Day 1: 3 non-national deaths, 2 successes, so one of regional/gazette/foreign is unreachable (call it Z). Day 2: 2 of 4 forum/clips victims succeeded, so exactly one of forum/clips is unreachable (U) and the other (P) already has 2 successes. Next success in P teaches L P, which costs about x0.25 of pool. Regional/gazette/foreign: the two reachable ones each have 1 success. Budget: pool ~55000; each newly learned place costs x0.25 (gazette x0.2). Pool <=1000 at a day's end means caught, so at most 2 more learned places are safe. Once a place is learned, kills there are free. Free kills: national, both forum and clips victims (after P is learned), and the unreachable regional/gazette/foreign place. Expect pool to fall to ~1e4 if P is learned, and deaths_traced to rise by 2 (4 to 6). Next day: check press conference. If deaths_traced rises by 2 with only forum/clips kills, P is confirmed. Then kill both forum and clips freely. Avoid regional/gazette/foreign unless needed, since two of them are reachable and each would reach 3 with two more successes. Keep tracking deaths per block for the routine rules.
